To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the attribution of success or failure in social situations is a function of the dimensions of locus of causality, stability, and internality, whereas the attribution of success and failure in academic situations is a function only of locus of causity.
The attribution theory is a theory that explains how we make causal explanations of events.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of the concept of attribution and with the development of an attributional coding scheme for social and academic situations.
the development of a multi-dimensional coding scheme of attributions in social and academic situations.
the development of a multidimensional coding scheme for causal attributions in social and academic situations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
causal attributions are the explanations of why things are the way they are, and that they can be categorized along two main dimensions: internal/external and stable/ unstable.
there are three main dimensions of attribution theory, namely, locus, stability, and controllability.
the causal attribution theory is a multi-dimensional model of causality that has been applied to a wide range of phenomena.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a person’s causal attributions in social situations are influenced by the social and cultural contexts of the situations.
the attributional model is a useful tool in the study of the causes of behavior, but it does not provide a full explanation of the causes of human behavior, especially as applied to social behavior.
we have developed a coding scheme that can be used in the analysis of the causal attributions of both social and academic events.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can understand the causal attributions of people by analyzing the language that they use.
there is no single, universal causal attribution model.
we can use attribution theory to understand the way that people make sense of events.
